SGOV.fund_title: iShares 0–3 Month Treasury Bond ETF product brief
SGOV.rationale: Start with the 4.26% 13-week Treasury yield as a spot reference. Use the short-Treasury index projection for the base because rolling bills reinvest at future rates. The proxy need not match SGOV’s precise maturity range or seven-year horizon.

SCHR.fund_title: Schwab Intermediate-Term U.S. Treasury ETF fund profile
SCHR.fund_published: Live profile; separate publication date unavailable
SCHR.rationale: Use the older, closer intermediate Treasury index proxy. Schwab reported 5.11% average yield to maturity on September 30 and 4.8 years effective duration on October 31, 2026. Yield to maturity describes the bonds at observed prices under yield assumptions. Rate moves, roll and reinvestment affect ETF total return.

USIG.fund_title: iShares Broad USD Investment Grade Corporate Bond ETF fund profile
USIG.fund_published: Live profile; separate publication date unavailable
USIG.rationale: Use a broad investment-grade total-return index proxy. iShares reported 5.95% average yield to maturity and 6.09 years effective duration on November 18. Yield and distribution measures do not capture future rate or spread moves, credit defaults and recoveries, or reinvestment. Bloomberg and USIG’s ICE index differ.

VT.fund_title: Vanguard Total World Stock ETF fact sheet
VT.fund_published: September 2026 edition; exact publication day unavailable
VT.rationale: Use the broad developed/emerging USD equity projection. MSCI ACWI covers large and mid caps, while VT follows FTSE Global All Cap and includes small caps. Currency, valuation, earnings, tracking and the 10-year versus seven-year horizon remain uncertain.

analyst_costs.definition: The base inherits 10 bp per year of additional portfolio-level cost. The 0–30 bp sensitivity is a recurring cost budget, with custody/advisory charges unverified. A separate 5–20 bp one-time spread/slippage illustration per dollar traded is excluded from annual returns. No executable quote, account terms or trade pattern are assumed.
